### MasterCraft Boat Holdings, Inc. to Webcast Fiscal First Quarter 2026 Transition Period Earnings Conference Call Tuesday, November 10, 2026


October 27, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s21.q4cdn.com/160811043/files/doc_news/MasterCraft-Boat-Holdings-Inc--to-Webcast-Fiscal-First-Quarter-2026-Transition-Period-Earnings-Conference-Call-Tuesday-November-10-2026-2026.pdf)


*Live webcast at 8:30 a.m. EST*


VONORE, Tenn.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- MasterCraft Boat Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: MCFT) (the “Company”) will host a live webcast of its fiscal first quarter 2026 transition period earnings conference call on Tuesday, November 10, 2026, at 8:30 a.m. EST. Brad Nelson, Chief Executive Officer, and Scott Kent, Chief Financial Officer, will discuss the Company’s financial results. The Company will issue a pre-market earnings release prior to the call on November 10, 2026.


Participants may access the conference call live via webcast on the investor section of the Company’s website,[Investors.MCBH.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.mcbh.com%2Foverview%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54624637&newsitemid=20261027556438&lan=en-US&anchor=Investors.MCBH.com&index=1&md5=5ae7b7d9ae63dd7512fc7f91fb1a9c99) , or by clicking on[this link](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fevents.q4inc.com%2Fattendee%2F474743876&esheet=54624637&newsitemid=20261027556438&lan=en-US&anchor=this+link&index=2&md5=cd981b6d71d9286d236dd6d7ed5833c2) . To participate via telephone, please register in advance at[this link](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fevents.q4inc.com%2Fanalyst%2F474743876%3Fpwd%3D8yeEPTo8&esheet=54624637&newsitemid=20261027556438&lan=en-US&anchor=this+link&index=3&md5=8241d92f01a52b1151c753d53c14b76e) . Upon registration, all telephone participants will receive a confirmation email detailing how to join the conference call, including the dial-in number along with a unique passcode and registrant ID that can be used to access the call. A replay of the conference call and webcast will be archived on the Company’s website.


**About MasterCraft Boat Holdings, Inc.**


Headquartered in Vonore, TN, MasterCraft Boat Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ: MCFT) is a leading innovator, designer, manufacturer and marketer of recreational powerboats through its five brands, MasterCraft, Crest, Balise, Chaparral, and Robalo. For more information about MasterCraft Boat Holdings, and its five brands, visit:[Investors.MCBH.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Finvestors.mcbh.com%2F&esheet=54624637&newsitemid=20261027556438&lan=en-US&anchor=Investors.MCBH.com&index=4&md5=b357f0757835b6596ce2c6ff2ebd9614) ,[www.MasterCraft.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.mastercraft.com%2F&esheet=54624637&newsitemid=20261027556438&lan=en-US&anchor=www.MasterCraft.com&index=5&md5=483dc0b30cbd06aac4287e3a9a7d8c17) ,[www.CrestPontoonBoats.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.crestpontoonboats.com%2F&esheet=54624637&newsitemid=20261027556438&lan=en-US&anchor=www.CrestPontoonBoats.com&index=6&md5=d0137ef61db19cae60d59b125f854c8e) ,[www.BalisePontoonBoats.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.balisepontoonboats.com%2F&esheet=54624637&newsitemid=20261027556438&lan=en-US&anchor=www.BalisePontoonBoats.com&index=7&md5=2c96c7be6e8e6748e0f32c7e11878a49) ,[www.ChaparralBoats.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.chaparralboats.com%2F&esheet=54624637&newsitemid=20261027556438&lan=en-US&anchor=www.ChaparralBoats.com&index=8&md5=58e1872d69d0aef04983dc01230b5e61) , and[www.Robalo.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.robalo.com%2F&esheet=54624637&newsitemid=20261027556438&lan=en-US&anchor=www.Robalo.com&index=9&md5=c7112e214a0ab0b8b88072fe270a8c58) .
